column1: # Names for WARBREED.EXE (GOG build, image base 0x400000). Applied by tools/ghidra/ApplyNames.java
# (see re/ghidra.md); the older tools/ghidra/ExportCaches.java of the New Game+ skill reads the
#   name     Class::Method for __thiscall methods (the function goes into that class namespace and the
#            decompiler types `this` as Class *), g_Name for globals, vtbl_Class for vtables,
#            Function_What for labels inside a function (patch and call sites). Free functions:
#   note     starts with a confidence letter: H read from the code, M mechanism clear but purpose
#            inferred, L a guess to test. [file] / [topic] says where it was established; "(also: X)"
#            records a different name another source gave the same address.
#   type     a C prototype for functions ("short __thiscall AGrid::Foo(short x, short y)"; the name in it
#            is ignored) or a C type for globals ("AGrid", "Scene *[4]"). Leave empty unless sure.
# Class vocabulary: "World" in src/game.h and the older reports is the RTTI class AThingRegistry
# (the object at [0x579278]); the static map/terrain object at 0x55dd60 is the RTTI class AGrid.
# Virtual functions nobody has named yet appear as Class::vfXX (XX = vtable slot offset) and
# constructors/destructors as Class::Class / Class::~Class: ApplyNames derives those from RTTI.
# Sorted by address. Add new lines anywhere; keep one line per address.
